_note: Human curation: which images lead each gallery, and what the homepage opens on.
capture/live-images.json answers 'did she publish this?' — a rights question.
It does NOT answer 'is this her best work?'. Deriving the hero from the old
WordPress homepage produced a behind-the-scenes shot of a film set, a beard
trim and some plaster hands, in place of the character builds the design was
built around. Those are different questions and need different sources.
Keyed by ORIGINAL upload path, not by manifest key: scripts/organize.mjs
renumbers keys whenever categories shift, so `sfx/sfx-048` is not a stable
Anything listed here still has to pass the rights gate. Listing an image
she never published does not clear it — see cleared-images.json for that.
first screen shows range rather than four variations of one craft.
hero    = the homepage opening reel. The strongest character work, full stop —
NOT one image per discipline. Spreading it across categories diluted
the opening; the discipline strips below already carry the range.
covers  = the image on each discipline plate further down the homepage.
leads   = what each discipline gallery opens on.
All four are plain lists of source paths. An admin UI, if one is ever built,
writes this file and nothing else changes.
